notes: Item 19 discloses Average Annual Gross Cash Collected for calendar year 2025 across 43 Area Franchise Businesses (master franchisees), reported cumulatively and by performance quartile. Metric is 'Gross Cash Collected' — a broad revenue measure including subfranchise sale proceeds, commercial cleaning account receipts, janitorial product sales, and marketing fees, WITHOUT deduction for taxes, Franchise Payables, or COGS. This is NOT net revenue to the master franchisee. Contract Fees (royalties, insurance admin, business support) average ~20.5% of Gross Cash Collected. There is a recurring internal inconsistency: the overall table header states 43 businesses but the pct_above_avg sentence says 45; the 2nd and 3rd quartile tables each show 10 businesses but the pct_above_avg sentences reference 11. outlet_count fields use the table values; the discrepancies are noted per record. Data excludes 3 affiliate-operated Area Franchise Businesses. Confidence slightly reduced due to these internal inconsistencies.
